title: Half the total variation equals the positive Jordan part
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $\mu-
u$ denote their signed measure difference. Writing $\abs{\mu-
u}$ for its total variation measure and $(\mu-
u)^{+}$ for the positive part of its Jordan decomposition, one has
\[
	frac{1}{2}\,\abs{\mu-
u}(\Omega) = (\mu-
u)^{+}(\Omega),
\]
where both sides are evaluated as real numbers on the whole space $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: μ is a probability measure on Ω
ν is a probability measure on Ω
